lines.text: Moses prays that the Lord has been their dwelling place through all generations, and is God from everlasting to everlasting.
God returns man to ashes, and in His sight a thousand years are like a day that passes.
People are like new grass that springs up in the morning but fades and withers by evening.
Moses says the length of our days is seventy years, or nine hundred if we are strong.
Moses asks that God's splendor be shown to their children and that He establish the work of their hands.
